cases.title: Strong intent starts target SOP and child Chatflow run
cases.acceptance: A fresh conversation routes to START_SOP, creates an active task, and exposes child runtime refs.

cases.title: Supplemental slot input continues active SOP
cases.acceptance: A follow-up slot message continues the active SOP and advances to the next waiting point or completion.

cases.title: Interruptible step suspends current SOP and starts new SOP
cases.acceptance: A new intent at an interruptible waiting node marks the first task SUSPENDED and starts a second child run.

cases.title: Completing the new SOP offers resume for the suspended SOP
cases.acceptance: After the secondary SOP completes, the turn includes a resume offer for the suspended primary task.

cases.title: Resume restores original child run instead of duplicating state
cases.acceptance: A resume signal returns to the original task and keeps the same child run id.

cases.title: Non-interruptible confirm step rejects switching
cases.acceptance: A new intent at a confirm node returns REJECT_SWITCH_CONTINUE_ACTIVE and keeps the current task active.

cases.title: Explicit resume wording restores the correct suspended child Chatflow
cases.acceptance: Phrases such as continue previous resume the intended suspended task.

cases.title: Ambiguous input clarifies without creating a child run
cases.acceptance: An unclear message returns CLARIFY and leaves task count unchanged.

cases.title: FAQ/RAG answers do not pollute active or suspended child state
cases.acceptance: Knowledge answers preserve the current active task and child runtime refs.

cases.title: Agent fallback answer does not replace SOP execution state
cases.acceptance: Fallback answers preserve active SOP identity and child runtime refs.

cases.title: Human handoff preserves conversation and runtime refs
cases.acceptance: HANDOFF_TO_HUMAN keeps conversation id and active/suspended child Chatflow refs.

cases.title: Multiple child Chatflows coexist through aggregate views only
cases.acceptance: Trace shows multiple child runs while RuntimeLab task/event ledgers omit execution-state mirrors.
